groups.name: Headings

styles.name: heading-24

styles.name: label-12-mono

shadow.note: Geist materials: every surface shadow starts with a 1px translucent edge, then soft, short layers. Floating materials lift more. Dark shadows are deeper.

tokens.name: shadow-border
tokens.usage: Material base: a 1px translucent edge instead of a border, so surfaces blend with whatever is behind them.

tokens.name: shadow-medium

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip

tokens.name: shadow-modal

tokens.name: shadow-fullscreen
